messages:
maria: Heads up — vendor legal ping: OpenModel Labs sent updated redistribution terms for the LlamaLuxe weights. Need quick read and posture for marketplace listing. TL;DR: they want attribution + export control addendum.
liam: Can you paste the clause?
maria: Here —
```
Redistribution clause excerpt:
- Redistribution: Licensee may redistribute model binaries only in object form; commercial redistribution requires prior written consent.
- Attribution: Must include: "Model: LlamaLuxe - OpenModel Labs" on any listing or packaging.
- Export controls: No exports to sanctioned jurisdictions; provider to supply export compliance certificate on request.
```
sasha: From infra side — we can support a marketplace SKU with embargo windows and geofencing. Need exact fields for export/country block.
jaya: Product question: Are they okay with dual-licensing? One for on-prem/private, another for hosted? That impacts hosting agreements.
liam: They proposed dual-license: Apache for research/non-commercial; commercial use requires a separate commercial license. That will complicate our hosted offering (may require carve-outs).
oliver: If commercial license required for hosted, recommend we default to BYOW (bring-your-own-weights) for hosted and list as a "partner-hosted" marketplace tile.
maria: They're open to revenue share on hosted. Also asked about quantized redistributions: "Will allow 8-bit/4-bit redistributions if checksum + provenance preserved."
liam: We need an addendum covering checksum/provenance and detection safeguards. Also require indemnity limits. Drafting now — will ping legal-bot when ready.
legal-bot: Reminder: upload draft to /legal/partners/ for review and set review tag @liam. Template: partner_distro_addendum_v1.
sasha: Ops note: For quantized artifacts, we must store provenance metadata: original model hash, quantization recipe, runtime kernel version. We can attach these to the SKU as structured metadata.
jaya: Marketing: timeline for joint announcement? They want co-announcement but will embargo until our Dedicated availability is validated. Proposed window: 3 weeks after signed SLA.
oliver: Can we commit to QA in 10 business days? Need model runbook + eval suite. @maria can you coordinate with eng-ml?
maria: Yes — I'll loop in eng-ml. Quick checklist I'll share: sample prompts, eval metrics, privacy/PII check, throughput targets, export clearance docs.
liam: One more question: confirm whether redistribution covers weights bundled with hardware partners (e.g., edge/appliance vendors). Needs explicit language.
maria: They replied: 'hardware partners allowed if distributor engages separate HW redistributor agreement.' We'll require proof of reseller contract and right-to-distribute docs.
jaya: Action items: liam — draft addendum (48h), maria — gather eval assets (72h), sasha — add SKU metadata fields & geofence options (5 days), oliver — draft announcement calendar & embargo window.
oliver: :thumbsup: Sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to finalize.
